long.title: Aruba Travel Guide: What to Know Before You Go
long.summary: A calm, practical guide to Aruba: the ED-Card and entry basics, getting from Queen Beatrix International Airport to your hotel, the best time to go, which coast to swim on, Arikok National Park, Oranjestad, San Nicolás and getting around.
